text:
sara-finance: FYI vendor 'PolarTelemetry AS' sent invoice PT-559 dated 2026-03-11 with 25% MVA charged. We expected a net B2B reverse-charge. Attached AP ticket #AP-9876. Please advise.
liam-legal: Quick heads-up: Norway's MVA rules differ from EU VAT; we need their Norwegian org number + MVA reg to determine if charge is valid. Ask for a copy of their registration certificate showing VAT status.
eva-sales: I messaged their rep; they said ops added VAT by mistake and can reissue. They asked for exact wording we need on the corrected invoice.
sara-finance: Proposed wording to request: "Please reissue invoice PT-559 without Norwegian MVA (reverse charge applies). If you insist on charging MVA, please supply Norwegian VAT (MVA) number and current registration extract so we can review reclaim options."
liam-legal: Add this to the template: request a credit note referencing PT-559 if they reissue. Also request bank details confirmation for payment remittance.
matt-payments: Hold AP processing for this invoice until we get a corrected invoice or docs. Approving hold now.
procurement: If vendor refuses to reissue, procurement will engage to enforce net pricing per SOW. Tag us on the vendor escalation thread.
vendor-bot: Notice: vendor record missing fields: mva_number, registration_document. Attach docs to clear hold.
sara-finance: Sent the email with suggested wording to vendor and CC'd legal/sales/procurement. AP ticket flagged 'on hold'.
sara-finance: Short checklist: 1) vendor reissue or provide MVA + reg extract; 2) payments confirm bank details on reissued invoice; 3) AP reprocess net invoice and reverse any VAT entry; 4) update vendor record in vendor master.
liam-legal: Keep place-of-supply notes in the AP ticket for audit trail and attach correspondence.
eva-sales: I'll follow up with the rep mid-day if no response.
sara-finance: Thanks — will update thread when vendor responds. Also ask ops to run a quick search for any PT- vendor invoices in last 90 days with MVA charged so we can batch if needed.
